title: Donkey Kong (Classic NES)
sources: own knowledge of the NES original

rows: Touch it to smash barrels/fire for a few seconds
Left on the clock when you reach the top

widgets.text: Barrels sometimes roll down ladders: never stand right below one. Fireballs follow you slowly; climb away from them. On the rivet stage, removing all eight rivets drops Donkey Kong.
The NES version has three stages: 25 m (girders and barrels), 75 m (elevators) and 100 m (rivets). After 100 m the loop repeats faster.
Hammers (two per stage on the girder levels) and Pauline's hat, purse and umbrella for bonus points.
Pauline drops her hat, purse and umbrella on the 75 m and 100 m stages: 300, 500 or 800 points each depending on the loop.
The bonus timer starts higher on early loops; each completed rivet stage starts the next, faster loop. Extra life at 7,000 points (game A).
